Implemented the approved pipeline in a single deterministic `analysis.py` (NumPy + SciPy only, seed 42, asserts shapes against system_info.json) and produced all six artifacts.

**File listing / shapes / dtypes (all verified):**
| File | Size | Check |
|---|---|---|
| analysis.py | 15,769 B | single runnable script, no placeholders |
| clusters.npy | (800,) int32 | 4 unique labels, sizes [418, 156, 125, 101] (relabelled by size) |
| pseudotime.npy | (800,) float64 | finite, range [0.0, 1.0], std 0.2208 |
| de_genes.json | {"gene_indices": [123, 214, 91, 163, 152, 132, 201, 140, 41, 138, 106, 230, 90, 127, 33, 135, 86, 235, 150, 158]} | 20 unique ints, all in [0, 250) |
| grn_scores.npy | (20, 20) float64 | finite, diagonal exactly 0, i→j convention |
| method_choices.json | 8 keys (seed + 7 steps) | per-step method, parameters, justification, assumptions |

**Key runtime diagnostics (0.5 s wall time):**
- Clustering: cosine KNN k=15 → normalized Laplacian eigvals [0, 0, 0.313, 0.360, 0.365, 0.373]; spectral k=4 (n_clusters from metadata) with 10 deterministic k-means++ restarts → sizes 418/156/125/101. Documented trade-off: silhouette favors k=2 (0.475 vs 0.290); the KNN graph splits into 2 components, so the 4-cluster solution is metadata-driven.
- Pseudotime: connected Euclidean KNN k=25 graph (connectivity asserted) → weighted MST → root = cell 544 (farthest geodesically from median cell 601) → t = normalized geodesic distance. Per-cluster t: cluster 0 (n=418, isolated): mean 0.821 [0.602–1.000]; clusters 1–3 (the tight triangle): means 0.452/0.431/0.388 near the root. Direction ambiguity documented.
- DE: Kruskal–Wallis H across the 4 clusters on raw counts; top-20 H range [135, 203]; all non-TF genes (none of 0–19 rank in), consistent with the "remaining genes include cluster markers" description.
- GRN: GENIE3-style ridge (λ=1.0) per-target regression on z-scored log1p-CPM TF block, target excluded from its own predictors; |score| max 0.191, mean 0.034 — small because TF–TF co-expression is weak (max |Spearman| ≈ 0.17); static-data directionality limitation documented.
- Determinism: re-running analysis.py produces byte-identical outputs (MD5-verified).
